verdict.line: You lose the poke-and-trade war to her Runic Blade autos and dashes, but you flip the lane the moment you land Q (Rupture) into W (Feral Scream) before she can react.

brief.thesis: Riven's entire kit is abilities — Q (Broken Wings), W (Ki Burst), E (Valor), R (Blade of the Exile) — so your W (Feral Scream) silence is a full kit-lock, not just a damage spell. The 44.1% win rate over 102 games says you lose the even trades she chooses; the solo-kill edge says you win the trade she doesn't choose. Your job is to deny the first kind and force the second.

theirWindow.when: Valor and Broken Wings both up
theirWindow.what: She dash-auto-dash-outs with Runic Blade-empowered hits and you can't punish it. Don't walk up to trade here — let the wave come to you and eat the poke.

yourWindow.what: She has no block and limited escape. Flash or walk in, land Q (Rupture, 9s cd, 950 range) for the knockup and slow, then follow with W (Feral Scream, 13s cd) to silence her out of Q/W/E/R entirely.

start.item: Doran's Ring + Health Potion + Health Potion
start.why: The 51.1% win rate (92 games, 67.7% pick) pick — the extra sustain and mana keep you throwing Rupture and Feral Scream through her poke without being forced all-in early.

boots.why: 48.1% win rate, 61.2% pick — flat reduction on her Runic Blade-empowered autos, which are the actual source of her trade advantage.

core.why: The dash closes the gap on a mobile target and lets you catch her mid-Broken Wings to land Rupture.
Sustained magic damage plus omnivamp lets you win extended trades instead of just the burst window.
This path hits 85.7% over 7 games; the speed stacks let you stick to her through Valor dashes instead of losing her.

situational.when: she's stacking attack speed or crit off Runic Blade autos
the lane turns into a slow poke war and you need more sustain to out-wait her
the game goes long and you want more raw HP to stack Feast into teamfights

runes.keystoneWhy: This page hits 57.1% win rate; Grasp procs on every auto you land through her poke, which fits the matchup's real plan — survive the trade war, don't win it, then flip it with Feast.

summoners.why: 52.5% win rate at 58.8% pick — this is a scaling matchup, not a dueling one, so Teleport lets you reset off the wave and still show up for objectives while Flash sets up the Rupture-into-Feral Scream all-in.

playing.title: Hold trades until Valor is down
playing.detail: Her E (Valor, 10-6s cd) is her only block and gap-close. If it's up, she dictates the trade — wait it out.

playing.title: Pre-cast Rupture on her path, not her feet
playing.detail: Q (Rupture) has 950 range but a visible wind-up; throw it where her Broken Wings dash is taking her, not where she's standing.

playing.title: Silence to cancel her combo, not just for damage
playing.detail: W (Feral Scream)'s silence stops Ki Burst, Valor, and Wind Slash cold — use it the instant she commits to an all-in, not just as a poke tool.

playing.title: Don't fight for CS, fight for level 6
playing.detail: OP.GG's own read holds: she wins skirmishes before you have R (Feast, 60s cd). Farm through the poke instead of contesting every wave.

playing.title: All-in the moment Feast comes up
playing.detail: R (Feast) is true damage on top of your Q-W combo — this is the exact mechanic behind your solo-kill advantage, so look for it on cooldown refresh, not just as a finisher.

playing.title: Back off after she lands two abilities
playing.detail: Her Runic Blade passive charges off ability use; an auto right after Ki Burst or Valor hits noticeably harder, so disengage instead of trading into it.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, and the 44.1% head-to-head win rate are measured from live games on the current patch via OP.GG; the cooldown timing, silence-lock, and dash-tell reasoning above is my own tactical read, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Keep your distance from her while keeping an eye on her Conqueror stacks. Focus on farming and contesting lane rather than fighting her.
